system.flavor:
Snatch a friend out from under a falling roof, haul a child clear of a bolting cart, pull a companion back from a crumbling ledge, yank someone out of a river current, or drag a friend out of a fire's reach.

Not enough to pull more than one person or carry them further than a few steps.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An area Action is declared that includes the ally, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Pull the ally up to 2 units toward you along a clear path, then recheck whether it remains in the area.

surges.html: If it remains in the area, reduce that Action's Damage to it by 1.
